extracted.name: Cranberry Pear Salad
extracted.description: Sliced pears, dried cranberries, Havarti cheese, pecans, and almonds make this pear cranberry salad go from simple to sensational.
instruction_lines: Whisk olive oil, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, garlic, salt, and black pepper in a medium bowl.
Combine greens, pears, cranberries, pecans, and Havarti cheese in a large bowl. Pour balsamic vinegar dressing over salad and toss. Garnish with almonds to serve.
